<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/run"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the runs of the caller's organization, newest first, with their result counts instead of their results. Campaign runs and their attack runs are listed alike: `parent__isnull=true` keeps campaign runs only, `parent=<id>` lists the attack runs of one. Paginated with `page` and `page_size` (default 10, at most 100). Staff users see every organization's runs. The dashboard's campaign run list is `GET /run/summary`.
